name: Warcania
storyline:
The city of Warcania stands on the edge of a dying world, ringed by crypts, cursed forests and a tower that has no top. Monsters gather in the dark beneath its streets, and the Bone Regent waits on his throne at the bottom of the Descent.

You arrive as fresh blood with nothing but a name. The Barkeep hands out the first contracts, the arena crowd wants a new champion, and the guilds are already at war over the city’s riches. Take on quests, survive the dungeons, forge your gear and rise from a nameless recruit to a legend of Warcania.
summary: Warcania is a free dark-fantasy pixel-art RPG played in the browser on desktop and mobile, with no download. Create a Warrior, Mage, Rogue or Paladin and level up through timed quests, offline expeditions, an asynchronous PvP arena, 14 dungeon bosses, the Endless Tower and The Descent, a roguelike crypt run. Join a guild for guild wars and a guild boss, fight the weekly world boss, enhance your gear up to +10 in the Forge and trade on the player market. A game in the spirit of Shakes & Fidget.
